arxiv-2001-00518.title: A study of topological structures on equi-continuous mappings Thanks: Corresponding author : : Ankit Gupta This paper was prepared during a sabbatical leave of the second author.
arxiv-2001-00518.creator: Ankit Gupta 1 and Ratna Dev Sarma 2
arxiv-2001-00518.description: Abstract . Function space topologies are developed for E ​ C ​ ( Y , Z ) EC(Y,Z) , the class of equi-continuous mappings from a topological space Y Y to a uniform space Z Z . Properties such as splittingness, admissibility etc. are defined for such spaces.

arxiv-2007-04822.title: On fractional-order maps and their synchronization
arxiv-2007-04822.creator: Prashant M. Gade, Sachin B. Bhalekar
arxiv-2007-04822.description: Abstract We study the stability of linear fractional order maps. We show that in the stable region, the evolution is described by Mittag-Leffler functions and a well defined effective Lyapunov exponent can be obtained in these cases. For one-dimensional systems, this exponent can be related to the corresponding fractional differential equation.

arxiv-2012-05698.title: Independent Sign Language Recognition with 3D Body, Hands, and Face Reconstruction
arxiv-2012-05698.creator: Agelos Kratimenos, Georgios Pavlakos, Petros Maragos
arxiv-2012-05698.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Agelos Kratimenos, Georgios Pavlakos, Petros Maragos. Independent Sign Language Recognition is a complex visual recognition problem that combines several challenging tasks of Computer Vision due to the necessity to exploit and fuse information from hand gestures, body features and facial expressions. While many state-of-the-art works have managed to deeply elaborate on these features independently, to the best of our knowledge, no work has adequately combined all three information channels to efficiently recognize Sign Language.

arxiv-2104-09975.title: Exactness of Bousfield localizations of simplicial presheaves and local lifting
arxiv-2104-09975.creator: Fritz Hörmann
arxiv-2104-09975.description: Abstract 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification: 18N40, 55U35 Keywords: left Bousfield localizations, exact localizations, simplicial presheaves, Čech localizations, (\infty,1) -topoi Abstract We show that weak equivalences in a (cofibrantly generated) left Bousfield localization of the projective model category of simplicial presheaves can be characterized by a local lifting property if and only if the localization is exact.

arxiv-2111-07830.title: Velocities of an Erupting Filament
arxiv-2111-07830.creator: Shuo Wang, Jack M. Jenkins, Karin Muglach, Valentin Martinez Pillet, Christian Beck, David M. Long, Debi Prasad Choudhary, James McAteer
arxiv-2111-07830.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shuo Wang, Jack M. Jenkins, Karin Muglach, Valentin Martinez Pillet, Christian Beck, David M. Long, Debi Prasad Choudhary, James McAteer. Solar filaments exist as stable structures for extended periods of time before many of them form the core of a coronal mass ejection.

arxiv-2203-16849.title: The effect of three matters on KSS bound
arxiv-2203-16849.creator: Mehdi Sadeghi
arxiv-2203-16849.description: Abstract In this paper we introduce the black brane solutions in AdS space in 4-dimensional (4D) Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet-Yang-Mills theory in the presence of string cloud and quintessence. Shear viscosity to entropy density ratio is computed via fluid-gravity duality, as a transport coefficient for this model. PACS numbers: 11.10.Jj, 11.10.Wx, 11.15.Pg, 11.25.

arxiv-2212-02297.title: Finite-dimensional diffeological vector spaces being and not being coproducts
arxiv-2212-02297.creator: Ekaterina P ervova
arxiv-2212-02297.description: Abstract It is known that for a topological vector space it is possible to be the coproduct of two of its subspaces in the category of vector spaces but while not being the coproduct of the same subspaces in the category of topological vector spaces.

arxiv-2310-20294.title: Robust nonparametric regression based on deep ReLU neural networks Thanks: This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under grant agreement N o 811017
arxiv-2310-20294.creator: Juntong CHEN
arxiv-2310-20294.description: Abstract . In this paper, we consider robust nonparametric regression using deep neural networks with ReLU activation function. While several existing theoretically justified methods are geared towards robustness against identical heavy-tailed noise distributions, the rise of adversarial attacks has emphasized the importance of safeguarding estimation procedures against systematic contamination.

arxiv-2312-14552.title: Machine learning for structure-guided materials and process design
arxiv-2312-14552.creator: Lukas Morand*, Tarek Iraki, Johannes Dornheim, Stefan Sandfeld, Norbert Link, Dirk Helm
arxiv-2312-14552.description: Abstract In recent years, there has been a growing interest in accelerated materials innovation in the context of the process-structure-property chain. In this regard, it is essential to take into account manufacturing processes and tailor materials design approaches to support downstream process design approaches.

arxiv-2410-07500.title: Learning to Generate Diverse Pedestrian Movements from Web Videos with Noisy Labels
arxiv-2410-07500.creator: Zhizheng Liu, Joe Lin, Wayne Wu, Bolei Zhou
arxiv-2410-07500.description: Abstract Understanding and modeling pedestrian movements in the real world is crucial for applications like motion forecasting and scene simulation. Many factors influence pedestrian movements, such as scene context, individual characteristics, and goals, which are often ignored by the existing human generation methods.

arxiv-2410-08714.title: A Simple yet Exact Analysis of the MultiQueue
arxiv-2410-08714.creator: Stefan Walzer, Marvin Williams
arxiv-2410-08714.description: Abstract The MultiQueue is a relaxed concurrent priority queue consisting of n n internal priority queues, where an insertion uses a random queue and a deletion considers two random queues and deletes the minimum from the one with the smaller minimum. The rank error of the deletion is the number of smaller elements in the MultiQueue. Alistarh et al.

arxiv-2503-23424.title: What Makes an Evaluation Useful? Common Pitfalls and Best Practices Thanks: ©2024 Pattern Labs. All rights reserved.
arxiv-2503-23424.creator: Gil Gekker, Meirav Segal, Dan Lahav, Omer Nevo
arxiv-2503-23424.description: Abstract Following the rapid increase in Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities in recent years, the AI community has voiced concerns regarding possible safety risks. To support decision-making on the safe use and development of AI systems, there is a growing need for high-quality evaluations of dangerous model capabilities.

arxiv-2512-08933.title: Agentic AI as Undercover Teammates: Argumentative Knowledge Construction in Hybrid Human-AI Collaborative Learning
arxiv-2512-08933.creator: Lixiang Yan, Yueqiao Jin, Linxuan Zhao, Roberto Martinez-Maldonado, Xinyu Li, Xiu Guan, Wenxin Guo, Xibin Han, Dragan Gašević
arxiv-2512-08933.description: Abstract Generative artificial intelligence (AI) agents are increasingly embedded in collaborative learning environments, yet their impact on the processes of argumentative knowledge construction remains insufficiently understood. Emerging conceptualisations of agentic AI and artificial agency suggest that such systems possess bounded autonomy, interactivity, and adaptability, allowing them to engage as epistemic participants rather than mere instructional tools.

arxiv-2601-06983.title: Hybrid Bound States in the Continuum beyond Diffraction Limit
arxiv-2601-06983.creator: Ji Tong Wang, Nicolae C. Panoiu
arxiv-2601-06983.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Ji Tong Wang, Nicolae C. Panoiu. Bound states in the continuum (BICs) have greatly impacted our ability to manipulate light-matter interaction at the nanoscale. However, in periodic structures, BICs are typically realized below the diffraction limit, thus leaving a broad spectral domains largely unexplored.

pmc-10660083.description: A nascent category of anticancer therapeutic drugs called antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) relate selectivity of aimed therapy using chemotherapeutic medicines with high cytotoxic power. Progressive linker technology led to the advancement of more efficacious and safer treatments. It offers neoteric as well as encouraging therapeutic strategies for treating cancer.

pmc-10707542.title: Impacts of visual impairment on pragmatic impairment: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10707542.creator: Cheng Lulu, Hong Xie, Peng Wang, Ting Zhang
pmc-10707542.description: BackgroundConsideration for patients with visual impairment, from low vision to blindness, is an important part of building a barrier-free society. Some authors have elaborated that visual impairment can indeed lead to delayed development in theory of mind, thereby causing pragmatic knowledge deficiency.

pmc-10754555.title: The association between COVID-19 vaccination and confirmed patients with hospitalization in Omicron era: A retrospective study
pmc-10754555.creator: Ming-Hung Chang, Kuang-Ming Liao
pmc-10754555.description: With the emergence of Omicron variant of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2, Taiwan has encountered the greatest coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic since 2022 spring. We analyzed the characteristics, vaccinations, and outcomes of hospitalized COVID-19 patients quarantined in a dedicated ward.

pmc-11387172.title: Amygdalar involvement in respiratory dysfunction
pmc-11387172.creator: Pedro Trevizan-Baú, John A. Hayes, Donald C. Bolser, Leah R. Reznikov
pmc-11387172.description: The brainstem has long been recognized as the major respiratory control center, but it has become increasingly appreciated that areas upstream of the brainstem modulate respiration and airway defensive behaviors. This review aims to define the role of the amygdala, a key temporal brain region essential for limbic function, in respiration and airway defenses.

pmc-11489272.title: Acquired Low Factor XIII Activity Is Associated with an Increased Need for Blood Transfusions in Patients with Gastrointestinal Bleedings
pmc-11489272.creator: Anna Traninger, Andreas Blesl, Andrea Borenich, Stefan Fürst, Thomas Wagner, Reinhard Bernd Raggam, Andrea Berghold, Christoph Högenauer
pmc-11489272.description: BackgroundFactor XIII plays a key role within the coagulation cascade.ObjectiveWe aimed to investigate the relevance of factor XIII activity on the outcome of patients with gastrointestinal bleedings.MethodsIn this retrospective, single-center study patients with gastrointestinal bleeding and measurement of factor XIII activity were included.

pmc-11492535.title: Lactobacillus helveticus attenuates alcoholic liver injury via regulation of gut microecology in mice
pmc-11492535.creator: Jiawen Lv, Guanjing Lang, Qiangqiang Wang, Wenlong Zhao, Ding Shi, Ziyuan Zhou, Yangfan Shen, He Xia, Shengyi Han, Lanjuan Li
pmc-11492535.description: Previous reports have demonstrated that alcohol consumption significantly reduces the abundance of Lactobacillus in the gut. In this study, we selected five species of the genus Lactobacillus, commonly found in fermented foods, and acknowledged them as safe, edible, and effective in preventing or treating certain diseases, to evaluate their effects on alcoholic liver disease (ALD).

pmc-11496690.title: Isolation and characterization of salt-stress-tolerant rhizosphere soil bacteria and their effects on plant growth-promoting properties
pmc-11496690.creator: Naveena Radhakrishnan, Chitra Krishnasamy
pmc-11496690.description: PGPR has a higher potential impact on agricultural crops. It enhances plant growth and development in a variety of adverse environmental conditions, including biotic and abiotic stresses. The PGPR is commercially vital since it is more efficient, safe for the environment, and beneficial to the economy. Nowadays, salt stress has an impact on the agricultural ecosystem.

pmc-13443863.title: Double deep reinforcement learning twin-delayed agents for performance improvement of a grid-connected wave energy conversion system
pmc-13443863.creator: Faisal Aldawsari, Ahmed Mahdy, Ziad M. Ali, Ahmed F. Zobaa, Shady H. E. Abdel Aleem, Hany M. Hasanien
pmc-13443863.description: This study introduces a novel approach using two deep learning agents, trained with the twin-delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (TD3) algorithm, to replace the PI controllers used for the control of grid-connected Archimedes Wave Swing (AWS) wave energy conversion systems.
